title: Java Developer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


Citi is looking for a Java Developer to join the Equity Derivatives Trade Management team in Pune, building high\-performing, enterprise\-grade applications that directly reduce operational risk and support business growth across global markets. In this role, you will collaborate with front office, operations, and product development teams to design and deliver scalable backend solutions that shape the future technical direction of high\-profile trading platforms. This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of functional components and make a measurable impact across teams at one of the world's leading financial institutions.


**Responsibilities**


* Design and develop scalable, enterprise\-grade Java backend applications that improve operational efficiency and reduce risk across the Equity Derivatives business.
* Build and maintain solutions spanning the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and technical design through to deployment and ongoing support.
* Translate business and client requirements into well\-structured technical designs, providing effort estimates and clearly communicating delivery approach.
* Conduct code reviews and test case reviews to ensure delivered software meets functional requirements and quality standards.
* Identify and proactively communicate delivery risks with sufficient lead time to protect project outcomes.
* Collaborate with front office, operations, and product teams to understand needs and propose technically sound solutions that serve clients effectively.
* Apply expertise in systems analysis and component\-level design, coding, unit testing, and debugging to deliver reliable, production\-ready software.

  

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**


* 5 to 8 years of hands\-on experience developing backend applications in Core Java (version 1\.7 or above) within an enterprise environment.
* Solid command of object\-oriented programming principles, applied consistently to produce maintainable and extensible code.
* Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to write and interpret queries in support of application data requirements.
* Experience integrating with at least one messaging middleware platform such as Tibco EMS, Solace, or IBM MQ.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables with minimal supervision in a fast\-paced, project\-driven environment.
* Track record of contributing across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, coding, testing, and delivery.
* Beneficial Skills \& Qualifications
* Familiarity with HTML5 and React.js, enabling contribution to front\-end integration work where required.
* Experience working within capital markets, trading, or financial services technology teams, with exposure to equity derivatives or similar product areas.
* Exposure to agile delivery environments, with the ability to adapt to evolving project requirements and shifting priorities.

**What We Offer**


* Joining Citi's Equity Derivatives Trade Management team in Pune means working on technically complex, high\-profile platforms where your contributions directly influence the quality and direction of systems used across global markets. You will work alongside driven, experienced engineers in a collaborative, performance\-focused environment built on trust and mutual respect.
* Hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you structure alongside genuine flexibility.
* Autonomy to take ownership of functional components and influence the technical direction of enterprise\-scale applications.
* Exposure to complex financial technology in the equity derivatives space, broadening your experience in high\-impact engineering domains.
* Access to learning and development opportunities that support continued technical growth and career progression.
* A collaborative team environment where creative problem\-solving and engineering excellence are actively encouraged.
* The scale and reach of a global financial institution, with the opportunity to see your work affect real outcomes for clients worldwide.

YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  

At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  

We are looking forward to hire MS Power Platform Professionals in the following areas :
  
  

**Job description:**  

Power Platform Developer
  
  

**Required skills:**  

Degree \- preferably in IT/Engineering, Master/Bachelors in Science or any other related disciplines
  
5\-7 years of overall experience as individual contributor as well as team player working successfully in a technical role with business users or end users.
  
Delivering services and solutions for the customers as part of the Power Platform Team using the suite of Microsoft’s PowerApps, Power BI, Power Automate Flow, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, custom development, and data integrations on the platform.
  
Working directly with business to support various projects and provide solutions.
  
Developing PowerApps model and canvas driven apps.
  
Installing and configuring data gateways.
  
Providing architecture, configuration, administration, and functional support to expand capabilities in Microsoft 365\.
  
Designing end\-to\-end solutions that improves collaboration, productivity, and knowledge sharing.
  
Identifying areas and processes where Microsoft 365, Office 365, Dynamics 365, and SharePoint can be better leveraged and facilitate process improvement.
  
The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in the Microsoft Power Platform \- MS PowerApps, MS Power Automate (Flow), Power BI and Power virtual agents. They should also have experience in analysis, design development, testing and implementation of enterprise scale apps.
  
Experience in successful software delivery / development / end to end life cycle management.
  
Experience with configuration, deployment and testing of enterprise software applications
  
Experience with any scripting language – JAVASCRIPT / Python / VBA / Pearl
  
Experience with SQL Server – DB design, Writing SQL queries and stored procedures
  
Good knowledge of BPM Fundamentals, Technical Features, Designer Features.
  
Experience in designing and developing integrations with 3rd party system. Must be expert in integration, connected systems, Web APIs, FTP, JMS and other web integration technologies.
  
Good working knowledge of .Net, C\#, ASP.Net MVC, Entity Framework, JavaScript, HTML and CSS is also desirable.
  
Constructs conceptual application architecture including records, reports, and news feeds
  
Designs conceptual workflows and related actions
  
Experience using any collaboration / knowledge management tools like SharePoint/Confluence
  
Ability to Plan, Multi\-task and Prioritize
  
Working knowledge in application servers, web servers, operating systems, and web application architectural concept
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Build applications / workflows of highest quality using the Microsoft Power Platform – MS PowerApps, MS Power Automate (Flow), Power BI and Power virtual agents.
  
Be cognizant of cost and schedule implications.
  
Support Lead Developer in Common Component development
  
Recommend and Develop Common Component development, integrations, and configurations
  
Drive best practices, design, development, testing, implementation and application reviews
  
Assists in translating business requirements to technical designs and specifications
  
Respond to queries raised by business and other members of Community of Practice (COP)
  
Actively participate in project meetings and discussions
  
Weekly, monthly and quarterly status reporting to relevant stakeholders
  
Project documentation
  
Timely escalations and issue management
  
Manage Stakeholders
  
Collaborate within and outside teams as required
  
Perform other ad\-hoc tasks or duties as assigned by reporting manager
  
Define coding best practices and standards and educate other on these practices
  
Comply to the organization norms, ethics and values
  
  

**Good To Have:**  

Experience with Agile / Scrum
  
Exposure to Agile tools – Jira / Trello etc.
  
Exposure to Testing frameworks / automated testing
  
Exposure to DevOps / CICD
  
Experience in any ETL (SSIS / Talend etc.) \& Reporting Tool (Tableau, SSRS Crystal etc.)
  
Experience in programming using JAVA / Dot Net
  
Background in user experience, UI design, or HCI
  
Experience working with on\- and off\-shore team members
  
  

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career\-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
  
  

Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles
  
  

Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
  
Agile self\-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
  
All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
  
Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture
